_purpose: Per-market reserve factor and interest-rate-model curve, consumed by scripts/applyMarketRiskParameters.ts AFTER deploy:full-stack + Unitroller admin acceptance. deploySecurdStack.ts deploys one shared JumpRateModelV2 for every market and never calls _setReserveFactor -- this file supplies the per-asset values from docs/securd-asset-listing-risk-parameters.md Part 4/5 that the shared deploy step cannot express. Values are annual-rate mantissas (1e18-scaled), matching JumpRateModelV2's constructor units (baseRatePerYear, multiplierPerYear, jumpMultiplierPerYear) and kink as a 1e18-scaled fraction.
_signerNote: cToken admin == DEPLOY_OWNER (the final owner/multisig set at construction time), NOT the deployer key. If DEPLOY_OWNER is a multisig, run scripts/applyMarketRiskParameters.ts with --print-calldata and submit the encoded calls through your multisig UI instead of direct-send.
